title: cjr — Run Cangjie programs
description: Start your Cangjie program with one command. Skip the search for runtimes and the manual setup. Available for Windows, Linux and macOS.
headline: Run Cangjie programs.
intro: Start your Cangjie program with one command. Skip the search for runtimes and the manual setup.
requirements: Choose your platform, extract the archive and add cjr to PATH. No Rust installation needed.
sourceRequirements: Requires Rust 1.89+, a C compiler and CMake.
runHint: Arguments after the path go directly to your application.
offline: Once cached, run offline with cjr --offline ./app. On Windows, use a path such as .\app.exe.
